## About
Finding the right collision and repair shop can be tough, especially while you're dealing with insurance claims, car rental and everything else after an accident. At Santa Fe Body, Inc in Overland Park, helping people through that stress is what we do.
We handle collision repair, frame straightening, and paint work or refinishing for cars and trucks. Customers often mention Lexi, Libby and Kit by name, and we hold a 4.8 rating from 100 Google reviews.
Stop by 8717 Lenexa Drive or give us a call. We'll do the job, do it right, and get you back on the road.

## Services
- Collision Repair: Body repairs after an accident, from a rear-end hit to a run-in with a deer, for cars and trucks.
- Frame Straightening: Straightening the frame so your vehicle is right again after a wreck.
- Paint Work or Refinishing: Paint and refinishing work done in our paint and repair facility.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help me deal with my insurance company?
A: Reviewers say we've answered their questions and worked with the insurance adjuster on their behalf. One said Kit handled the adjuster on his wife's car after she hit a deer.

Q: What kinds of repairs do you do?
A: We specialize in collision repair, frame straightening, and paint work or refinishing.
